gt_summary: P = a*(G/G_STC)*(1 + b*ln(G/G_STC))*(1 + gamma*(T - T_ref)): bilinear PVWatts with log-irradiance efficiency correction and linear thermal derating
submission_summary: P = G*(0.2218 - 0.0007*T + 2e-6*T^2): linear in G with quadratic temperature polynomial, no log-irradiance correction
matched: Power is linear (proportional) in irradiance G
Temperature derating present with correct sign (power decreases with T)
Uses correct two input variables (G, T_module)
missed: Missing log-irradiance efficiency correction term (1 + b*ln(G/G_STC)), which is the key distinguishing GT mechanism
Uses quadratic T dependence instead of linear thermal derating (1 + gamma*(T-T_ref))
No reference conditions (G_STC, T_ref) in the formulation
coefficient_assessment: The linear-in-G scale ~0.222 is roughly consistent with a/G_STC ≈ 0.204, but the quadratic T term is spurious and the missing log correction changes the functional shape meaningfully.
